comment: AISI 4140 bought quenched and tempered ('pre-hard'), commonly sold at 28-32 HRC. Hardness 286 HB: 30 HRC converted with the ASTM E140 hardness conversion tables. Density as 4140. kc1.1 2400 N/mm2: approximate, ISO 513 group P (hardened alloy steel). mc 0.24: approximate, the typical value of row 8, low alloy steel, quenched and tempered, in the material group table 'according to DIN / ISO 513 and VDI 3323' (ISCAR catalogue page 'Material Groups'). Cutting data for this material are in the tools' presets.
name: 4140PH (pre-hardened, 28-32 HRC)
